actions.name: Attest a statement with EIP-191 personal_sign
actions.summary: The signers of a Safe the room holds attest a sentence with EIP-191 personal_sign — the signature any EVM tool can check with ecrecover. The hosted module completes it at one recognized signer. Nothing settles.

steps.does: Room → + → Statement → Endorse with Attest → From <account>. Attest is account-bound: its policy is 'eip191@<CAIP-10>' of an account a member disclosed (a Safe), and its signer set is that account's disclosed signers. The hosted module builds it with threshold 1: one recognized signer completes it. The proposal publishes its policy, the effect, and the signing context: environment 'room', account = the room's topic, slot = the intent id, expiry = now + MUSTER_INTENT_TTL_S (7 days by default). The intent id is content-addressed from the effect and the policy.

Re-derives the digest from the logged effect and approves in-app with the secp256k1 authorization key (the composer says 'You attest with your secp256k1 authorization key'). The driver counts a signature only if it recovers to one of the account's signers; a duplicate folds once.
steps.signs: keccak256('\x19Ethereum Signed Message:\n' ‖ len(m) ‖ m), m = dCBOR ['eip191.personal_sign.v1', 'muster.effect.statement.v1', {text}], as a 65-byte recoverable secp256k1 signature; plus a muster attestation by the same key over P

reveals.field: contributions (the personal_sign signature and its attestation)

steps.does: Executable is the end: the signatures sit in the room's log, verifiable by anyone the room gives them to. coordinate_submit on it answers 'not-onchain': a room family has no settlement, and the card reads '✓ Endorsed — a signed group decision. Nothing settles on-chain.'

refusals.what: a signature that recovers to no signer of the account
refusals.why: it never counts; the live path answers 'rejected'
not valid, names no one, never fatal
invariant 1: the digest is re-derived; conformance refuses another effect's bytes

refusals.what: an Attest policy that names no account the room holds
refusals.why: Attest is an account-bound kind whose signers are the disclosed account's; the resolution rule (tested for 'safe') sends an account-bound policy without a disclosed account to an unsupported driver, never to a default

actions.ui: Room → + → Statement → Endorse with Attest → From <account> → text → Propose; card → Approve.

claims.claim: Only a signature that recovers to one of the account's disclosed signers counts

The personal_sign signature commits to the statement alone — no room, chain, account or expiry. Handed outside the room it verifies anywhere; only muster's attestation binds it to this room and intent
claims.party: whoever the room gives the signatures to

claims.claim: The signer set is what members disclosed for the account; the room checks a Safe's disclosure against the chain through the user's RPC
claims.party: the member who disclosed the account

evidence.what: EIP-191 signed data: version 0x45, '\x19Ethereum Signed Message:\n' ‖ len ‖ message
